text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): Nothing more is needed for the settings and engine control. Claude sessions can already change settings and start the engine on schedule through tools/engine_set.py, writing cloud-config. That is built but not released yet. The release (tests, ship.sh, release.yml) is acct-7542bf's job, and your phone only adopts the changes once you install that new APK. The tools already refuse to touch STOP ALL and the dead-man rules. Two things only you can do: (1) keep the routine fire secrets (CLAUDE_FIRE_<TAG>_URL and _TOKEN) set for all three accounts, so chat wakes work, and (2) press accept on file changes when asked. I'll flag it here if anything else comes up.
